description: Average Daily Traffic Counts - 2006 Study - Historical is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. This dataset is historical for 2006. For recent data, we recommend using or Average Daily Traffic (ADT) counts are analogous to a census count of vehicles on city streets. These counts provide a close approximation to the actual number of vehicles passing through a given location on an average weekday. Coverage: Chicago.
